deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Primary brand color — logo wordmark, link text, active nav icons, decorative accent fills. Unusually dark violet gives the wordmark the weight of a jersey number rather than a SaaS accent

twitch-purple.$description: Twitch Purple — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

broadcast-red.$description: Broadcast Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

dark-matter.$description: Dark Matter — Primary text, icon strokes, dark UI surfaces, featured stream overlays, footer text. Near-black with a faint warm cast

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, muted nav items, helper labels, inactive controls. The readable-but-quiet middle ground between Dark Matter and the canvas

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, thumbnail frames, button text, input fields, nav bar background. The elevated surface token

hairline.$description: Hairline — Dividers, card borders, input outlines, table separators. Visible but never structural

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Subtle border accents, low-emphasis separators where Hairline would be too prominent

shadow-smoke.$description: Shadow Smoke — Box-shadow tint on elevated cards and popovers — a cool neutral gray rather than pure black

inter.$description: Primary UI typeface for the entire interface — nav labels, body text, buttons, badges, metadata, tags. Stays at 11–14px everywhere; the 600 weight is reserved for nav items, button text, and emphasis labels while 400 carries body and helper text. The narrow size range is intentional: Twitch compresses information rather than scaling type to create hierarchy.

roobert.$description: Brand display font for the wordmark and section headings. The slight negative tracking (-0.01em) tightens the geometric forms into a custom-feeling logotype. Substituted by Inter when unavailable — the brand relies on the wordmark image for identity, not the typeface alone.
